findings.title: Datetime audit-log pagination fails when building cursors
findings.body: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` is selected for audit logs ordered by `-datetime`, but this implementation treats the sort value as a number and calls `math.floor(datetime)`. Building the first page's cursor therefore raises `TypeError`; even if that were fixed, `value_from_cursor` also returns the integer cursor value instead of converting it back to a datetime as `DateTimePaginator` does. Requests opting into optimized pagination cannot successfully paginate audit logs.

findings.title: Negative offsets are passed to unsupported Django queryset slicing
findings.body: This branch explicitly sends a negative start index to a Django `QuerySet`. Django does not support negative queryset indices or slices and raises `ValueError` when the queryset is evaluated, rather than interpreting them as reverse pagination. Since negative offsets are accepted by `Cursor.from_string`, an optimized-pagination request with a negative cursor offset will fail with a server error instead of returning a page.

findings.title: Changing buffer keys from Redis sets to sorted sets breaks in-flight buffers on deploy
findings.body: Previous versions stored these same `span-buf:s:*` keys as Redis sets. During a rolling deployment, buffers written by an old worker can still exist for up to the configured TTL; `ZADD` against one of those keys fails with `WRONGTYPE` (and the new Lua script's `ZCARD`/`ZUNIONSTORE` operations also expect sorted sets). Span processing for traces with in-flight old-format buffers will fail until those keys expire or are explicitly migrated/cleared.
